Commentary.Commentary: We are back with India's reply! The umpires walk out to the middle. Bangladesh Under-19 players take their field positions. Ayush Mhatre and Vaibhav Suryavanshi are the two openers for India Under-19. Maruf Mridha to kick off the proceedings with the new ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

India's Under-19 bowlers were excellent throughout the innings. They made proper use of the conditions and consistently kept on applying pressure with very few loose deliveries. Chetan Sharma and Hardik Raj picked two wickets while the rest of their bowlers chipped in with one with Nikhil Kumar, the only bowler who remained wicketless. India Under-19 used a total of seven bowlers throughout their innings. Now, they will now hope for their batters to chase down this total and secure a victory in this finals. Stay tuned, as we will be back in a short while for India’s run chase...

Kiran Chormale is in for a quick chat. He says they bowled according to the plans and have managed to keep the total down. Adds that they wanted to try and build pressure with dots and had hoped to keep the total to anywhere below the 230-run mark.

James contributed 40 runs before his dismissal, leaving Hossan to carry the innings forward. Hossan eventually fell just a few runs short of his half-century, getting out in the 38th over. Later, Farid Faysal scored a crucial 39 at the end as Bangladesh were ultimately bowled out for a total of 198 runs in the final over. A score that could be considered just below par but still fightable, considering the nature of the pitch.

Bangladesh Under-19 will be disappointed that they failed to cross the 200-run mark here! They were off to a challenging start, losing wickets early on and finding themselves in a precarious position at 66 for 3 after 19 overs. However, the partnership between Mohammad Shihab James and Rizan Hossan was pivotal in stabilizing their innings, as they forged a valuable 62-run partnership.

OUT! CAUGHT! Yudhajit Guha gets a wicket too and India bundle Bangladesh out for just 198 runs! They successfully manage to keep them under the 200-run mark!
